**Other information:**

New file `test/playwright/unit/core/IdGenerator.spec.mjs`, one `test(...)` per row of the issue's table, set up like `util/Array.spec.mjs`. Every test uses its own name; the default-name test reads the current `neo-<n>` and asserts only `n+1` / `n+2` for `''` and `'neo'`. The object matched every row, so nothing to report against `src/`.

What I ran:
- `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/core/IdGenerator.spec.mjs` → 6 passed
- `npm run test-unit` → 5291 passed, 3 skipped on the first run. Later runs on the same machine had 6–18 failures in `grid/*` (timing) and `buildScripts/checkPackageContents.spec.mjs` (`no JSON array found in npm pack --json output`: npm 11 prints `npm notice` lines on this machine). They fail the same way with this spec removed, so they're environmental, not caused by this PR.

AI disclosure: written with Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) as an assistant; I'm responsible for the change.
